fun_fact: Assam's **Kaziranga National Park** shelters two-thirds of the world's greater one-horned rhinos — a global conservation success. But it's back in the headlines: Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma** has indicated the eco-sensitive buffer zone around Kaziranga could be fixed at a minimum of just **1 km**, instead of the default **10 km** — a move that has stoked controversy over what it means for the rhinos and the wildlife corridors that ring the park.
